title: Understanding LASSO Regularization
text: LASSO regularization adds a penalty equal to the absolute value of the magnitude of coefficients. This can lead to some coefficients being exactly zero, effectively removing some features from the model.

title: Effect on Model Complexity
text: Using LASSO regularization can reduce model complexity by shrinking some coefficients to zero. How might this affect the model's performance on unseen data?

title: Analyzing MSE on Test Data
text: Consider how reducing model complexity with LASSO might impact the model's ability to generalize to new data. What are the possible effects on MSE on held-out test data?
